ui_bugs.issue: FIX 2 incomplete: [data-testid=topbar-register-btn] ('Get Started') has classes `hidden md:inline-flex gs-btn-primary` but computed display is `flex` at 390px, because `.gs-btn-primary { display: inline-flex }` in /app/frontend/src/index.css (line 126-138, plain CSS emitted after @tailwind utilities) overrides the single-class `.hidden` utility. Result: button renders at x=276..373, pushing [data-testid=topbar-menu-toggle] to 385..419 (right edge 419 > viewport 390) and header/document scrollWidth 419 vs clientWidth 390 — 29px horizontal overflow and the hamburger is visually clipped (still clickable). Fix options: render the button conditionally, use `max-md:!hidden`/`!hidden md:!inline-flex`, or move .gs-btn-* rules into `@layer components` so Tailwind utilities win.

action_items: Make 'Get Started' actually hidden below md in TopBar (Tailwind `hidden` loses to .gs-btn-primary's display:inline-flex) so the mobile header stops overflowing and the hamburger sits inside the 390px viewport.
Consider wrapping all .gs-btn-* rules in @layer components in index.css to prevent future Tailwind display-utility overrides.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css defines .gs-btn-primary/.gs-btn-ghost as plain CSS after @tailwind utilities, so any Tailwind display utility (hidden/inline-flex/block) combined with these classes is silently ignored — a systemic cascade trap; move them into @layer components.
App.js Protected reads window.location.pathname instead of useLocation(); it works today because Protected re-renders per route change, but a location-derived value would be safer and testable.

Tour no longer blocks sidebar clicks (z-[15]) so no need to skip it before nav, but skipping is still cheap. rca_of_the_issue: Tailwind's `.hidden {display:none}` is generated at the @tailwind utilities directive (index.css line 3), while `.gs-btn-primary {display:inline-flex}` is authored later in the same file outside any @layer. Both selectors have identical specificity (0,1,0), so source order makes .gs-btn-primary win, keeping 'Get Started' displayed at 390px; its 97px width plus the rest of the right cluster pushes the 34px hamburger past the 390px viewport, producing the 29px header overflow reported in iteration 15.
